basis: The frozen pilot plan permits one increase when either reasoner caps on more than ten percent of the forty development tasks.
unchanged: forty fixed task IDs and order
repeat_rule: Repeat A/B/D for every task where either original reasoner capped, irrespective of pass/fail. Retain every original task and output in the parent namespace.
reuse_rule: When neither reasoner capped, carry all completed outputs verbatim with the original measurement identity; the larger cap cannot alter a trajectory already terminated below it.
replay_rule: All saved reasoning token prefixes must match exactly. Capped streams may extend; uncapped completed streams and answers whose conditioning did not change must reproduce exactly. Stop on divergence or shortened prefixes; no replacement draw.
final_gates: Require all forty cases; stop before training if either reasoner still caps on more than four cases or any baseline quality gate fails.
